notes.title: With Eyes of Ice released on Steam
notes.content:
Hello everyone \o/

It's been a very long time since I made an announcement for this VN haha...

And it's not even specifically about this VN orz

I just thought I'd write a post here to let you know that I've recently released a shiny new otome VN, [i]With Eyes of Ice[/i], on Steam. It only took me, what, seven years to write another otome VN?
Time really flies...

I'm calling [i]With Eyes of Ice[/i] an otome VN, since it's about a female main character who is being pursued by multiple pretty boys, but unlike [i]TWU[/i] it's a linear VN. There aren't any choices or branches.

Still, if you liked [i]TWU,[/i] checking out [i]With Eyes of Ice[/i] might be worth your while. I think I've improved a fair bit as a writer since I wrote [i]TWU[/i], and the production values are definitely higher.

Oh, and one of the characters in [i]Eyes of Ice[/i] (Kai) is basically Asa from [i]TWU[/i]. I liked Asa a lot, so I just imported him into another story, with a similar design haha ;;

You can check out [i]With Eyes of Ice[/i] here, if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2355830

And I hope you enjoy it!

- ebi x
